decisions.reason: Although submarine interior lighting is more distant from the core range and only lightly presented so far, the firm is large, expanding, serves maritime users, and can afford to keep this early-stage niche option open while market uncertainty remains high.
A medical examination light builds on the firm’s lighting capabilities, was given a dedicated presentation, and is still too new to justify abandonment before more of its value becomes clear.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires fit the firm’s industrial customer base and engineering strengths very well, so real-options logic favors retaining this promising adjacent product after only one year on the market.
The designer task light is close to the established offer and was relaunched as a popular product, so the low uncertainty and strong fit make keeping it the most sensible choice.
